text:
max_sales: Quick note from Acadia Financial they're asking for two hard items before signing: (1) emergency key eviction <= 3 minutes for new writes, (2) line-item on invoice for HSM proxied calls. Can we confirm feasibility + sample SOW verbiage?

tara_se: Clarify "eviction" 1: do they mean stop-wrapping-with-old-key for new encryptions within 3m, or also immediate refusal of previously issued tokens?

max_sales: They only care that new writes don't use old keys within 3m. Reads can still work for up to 48h.

ivan_eng: Technically feasible with caveats. Flow we need: rotate key in KMS -> push new wrapping key to HSM proxy pool -> invalidate keycache -> optionally shorten TLS session TTLs to force new handshakes. If they want global 3m guarantee we'll need to force cache evict which spikes errors ~30-90s.

rene_sre: Runbook outline: 1) create new key material in customer's KMS 2) distribute to proxy nodes 3) send cache-invalidate RPC + rotate session certs if session-ttl enforcement requested 4) cut traffic to new key 5) monitor for errors and rollback threshold. Recommend canary window 60s, emergency path skip canary.

asha_security: Add audit trail requirement: signed rotation event logs + optional attestation blob from HSM vendor. Also need to know if they require FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or split-custody import ceremonies (M-of-N). Those increase lead time.

tyler_billing: Invoice: we can expose a SKU BYO-HSM-CALL with per-call metering. Need engineering to emit a metering tag on HSM proxied paths. Do they want per-call price or blended commit+overage?

max_sales: They asked for per-call visibility and suggested $0.008 per HSM call with a volume discount past 1.5M/mo.

tara_se: $0.008 seems borderline — engineering should estimate infra cost at burst. I'll propose tiered: $0.01 (<250k), $0.0075 (250k-1.5M), $0.005 (>1.5M) and offer a commit to reduce further.

ivan_eng: Cost note: per-call metering requires incremental telemetry and reconciliation with token counters. For 200 rps bursts it's fine; for 2k rps sustained we recommend reserved capacity. Also call latency: if proxy needs HSM unwrap per request, expect 120-350ms added. With session reuse + prefix caching we can get 95th ~100-150ms.

rene_sre: Networking: prefer VPC peering with static egress IPs. If NAT, expect head-of-line issues during cache flush. Firewall: allow outbound 443 to proxy cluster and ephemeral ports. I'll paste a starter snippet: ```tf
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" {
  vpc_id = var.customer_vpc
  peer_vpc_id = var.redwood_vpc
}
```

asha_security: For SOW language: "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to begin serving new write requests encrypted with newly-rotated keys within three (3) minutes of rotation initiation. Emergency revocation may require forced cache invalidation which can result in transient elevated error rates; Redwood will notify Customer and provide signed rotation audit artifacts upon request. Exceptions include infrastructure failures and network partitions." Thoughts?

legal-bot: Flag: "commercially reasonable efforts" may be ok for presales but customer asked for firm SLA. If they insist on measurable SLA replace with numeric target (e.g., "95% of new write requests in Customer's primary region will use new keys within 3 minutes"). Legal will add carve-outs.

tyler_billing: If we surface per-call line we'll need: (1) metering tag in PR, (2) SKU creation, (3) sample invoice layout. I can mock an invoice once the SKU & rates are confirmed.

tara_se: Action items: Ivan -> latency + error impact matrix for force-evict vs staged-evict at 50/200/800 rps; Rene -> networking template + peering vs NAT pros/cons; Asha -> exact attestation & docs checklist; Tyler -> draft tiered pricing + invoice example; Max -> schedule a 20m call with Acadia after we have numbers.

ivan_eng: I'll post numbers in 24h. Expect worst-case error spike 1-2% during forced eviction with 60-90s elevated latency.

asha_security: I'll DM Max the checklist (attestation pdf, HSM vendor cert, FIPS level, import ceremony needs).

max_sales: Thanks team. I'll hold off on committing SLA language until legal reviews the 95% wording. Also cc'ing solutions-legal. :thumbsup:

legal-bot: Note: please attach measurement method for SLA (metric name, collection window, and region scoping) when proposing numbers.

tyler_billing: CI note: metering flag exists behind FF: feature/per-call-metering-byo-kms. Ops already added tags for v1. Need production rollout to enable invoice visibility.

max_sales: Great. If anyone hits blockers ping me here. We'll aim for customer sync tomorrow morning.
